name: Blake
intro: [happy] There you are! I’ve been training on the farm all week.
My starter evolved. Did yours? Doesn’t matter. I’m winning this time.
lines: “Round two. I’ve been waiting all week.”
win: “Again?! Okay. You’re the real deal. See you at the next arena.”
hint: Blake waits in Clovercrest Town with an evolved starter. Bring a team around level 18.
